method: 4 concurrent public Ubuntu ISO HTTPS downloads through existing REALITY/Vision node; 15s; each flow capped 10MiB/s; 30 concurrent small HTTPS probes during load; client and server share 1vCPU host
benchmark_summary: idle: 10 successful probes; TTFB median 83.04 ms, p95 90.23 ms
loaded: 37 successful probes; TTFB median 93.40 ms, p95 1082.59 ms
Probe errors (curl failure or HTTP outside 200..399): 0
Aggregate download rate over longest download: 265.86 Mbit/s
Per-download fields: duration_s, bytes, bytes_per_second, HTTP code.
Download exit 28 means the requested time limit; other nonzero codes indicate failure.
If downloads finish early or fail, this is not a sustained loaded-latency test.
limitations: One credential with concurrent requests, not 30 independently active users.
Client/server share the same 1vCPU; download is public WAN and rate-capped, not a gigabit saturation result.
No before/after comparison was performed in this memory-capped run.
